7.3.3.5 Configurable SOVD APIs
This section describes how the
Diagnostic Server instance
realizes the config-
urable SOVD APIs as specified in ASAM SOVD[5]. By intent a dedicated set of APIs is
used for SOVD.
Despite there are already APIs for UDS for similar use cases, such as "UDS DataIden-
tifier vs. SOVD Data" or "UDS Routine vs. SOVD operation", there are slightly different
concepts in SOVD, starting with granularity of authentication or operation timeouts that
are better covered with dedicated SOVD APIs.
These SOVD methods are realized explicitly:
• SOVD data
• SOVD faults
• SOVD operations
• SOVD bulk-data
• SOVD configuration as parameter and configuration as bulk-data
• SOVD software update
• SOVD logs
7.3.3.5.1 SOVD API – Data Access
An SOVD
entity
allows read and write access to various types of data.
